headline: Row Reignites as Expanse and Coast See Fighting
war_summary: Since the morning edition the wires tell a changed story, with Fisherman's Row returned to life and fresh stirrings elsewhere. The Row logged eight changes in the last two hours to midday, thirty-two on the day about Black Well, Eidolo and Arcadia, now standing seven Colonial, one Warden with one in ruins, its latest turn stamped at the hour of filing. The Weathered Expanse remains the heavy sector, four changes in two hours, thirty-nine on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, now four Warden, three Colonial with two neutral, with more than twenty-three thousand casualties in the day and loss rates still quickening. Farranac Coast shows two changes in two hours, eight on the day about The Bone Haft and Transient Valley, now nine Colonial to one Warden with one neutral, while Callahan's Passage shows two changes in two hours at Crumbling Post, now nine Warden with one neutral, both amid thousands of casualties in the day. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle have gone quiet in the last two hours despite twenty-eight and twelve changes on the day respectively, while Mooring County remains without a fresh flip despite more than twelve thousand casualties in the day.
